note: Large hilltop RV park on Dolan Creek Road above Sturgis with views over the town, gravel full-hookup pull-through and back-in sites, a cabin, showers, laundry and wifi. Busiest during the Sturgis Rally, when sites carry a 10-night minimum and are booked by phone; no generators. --Claude

Rally 10-night minimum is a time-of-year minimum, not standing; weekend 2-night / holiday 3-4 night minimums 'may be required' - not standing.
